technique_name: Find and explain the permanent solution to the Syrian refugee crisis.
description: The Syrian refugee crisis is a complex and ongoing situation and there is no single, permanent solution. A comprehensive long-term solution would involve a coordinated effort to end the civil war and ultimately, the rebuilding of Syria. This would require an American-led, international coalition to provide humanitarian aid, seek peace through diplomatic means, and provide reconstruction assistance.
